checks: Exact pinned corpus/membership/file identities and required file byte limits
No dev/test membership-file contents or document contents opened; repository-tree metadata may include unselected paths. Retain selected training exposure hashes.
Preserve original surface and reading with no guessed readings or global NFKC
Account for ambiguous/special notation, parse failures, length and reading-contract failures without silently dropping the selected document
Verify actual Sakura full-reading Top-32 and production Top-6 paths when the current exporter is authenticated; missing gold remains an oracle miss
Record independent annotation provenance separately from human adjudication of this derived IME task
failure_policy: Hash/schema/source permission mismatch stops acquisition. No adaptive replacement or promotion to Gold. Benchmark incompleteness remains explicit.
purpose: Test whether existing third-party surface/reading annotations remove Sakura-dictionary-generated reading circularity; not Gold certification or final evaluation.
remaining_for_release: Representative independent population and complete cross-history audit
Task-specific label precision >=99.5% and Wilson 95% lower >=99.0% with valid independent observations
At least 3000 valid final holdout cases
Actual fixed-model/gate independent comparison and Gates A/B/C/D

selection.document_order: Sort training IDs by SHA-256 of canonical JSON [seed, document_id], choose the first 50 before reading annotation files.
selection.left_context: At most 64 preceding surface characters within the same sentence; start empty at sentence boundaries.
selection.no_target_document: Retain as no_target; do not replace or backfill.
selection.right_context: Do not expose following text to an evaluator or language judgment. Parsing source structure for offline extraction is separate from model features.
selection.target_order: Among morphemes whose surface contains a CJK unified ideograph, choose the smallest SHA-256 of canonical JSON [seed, document_id, sentence_index, morpheme_index]. Choose before converter access, regardless of reading validity, length or candidate presence.

source.annotation_origin: Human modifications of JUMAN/KNP analyses, as documented by the corpus authors; per-item accuracy and review independence are not certified.
source.rights_scope: Publicly provided for NLP research. No corpus text redistribution or model training authorized by this probe; preserve source notices and record unresolved downstream license/provenance limits.

success_criteria: Deterministic membership and extraction with complete 50-document accounting
Readings trace to the independent corpus column rather than Sakura dictionary inference
Forward conversion coverage or exact execution blocker recorded without manufacturing missing candidates
All claims limited to an exposed development feasibility probe
